blockers.description: Reopen evidence: The public `/status` page shows fixed data, not real-time status: every service is hard-coded `operational` (`apps/web/src/app/(public)/status/page.tsx`), the incident list is hard-coded, and the 90-day uptime bars come from `deterministicRatio()` pseudo-randomness in `status-monitor.tsx`. The DoD/KPI "real-time updates" fails, and the page breaks the repo rule "Never Mock or Simulate Data".
To close: (1) Drive the page from real checks (e.g. the availability checks from IFC-032's hosted backend, or a server-side health probe), and show "pending" where no data exists.
